task.zh: 左边已经有两个5，再放上第三个一样重的砝码就能和右边的15平衡。这个?有多重？
task.en: Left already has two 5s. Add a third weight of the same size to balance the 15 on the right. How heavy is ?

hints.zh: 三个一样的砝码合起来是15，一个是多少？
hints.en: Three identical weights make 15 — how much is one?
5 and 5 make 10 — how much more to reach 15?
